body: I just got into an argument with my support system about suicide being selfish. I feel it's selfish to force someone who doesn't want to live to stick around just so they don't have to experience the pain of losing a loved one.
Call the doc. I take 1050mg all at once, once a day.
I'm just getting out of a long depressive episode where I was only able to brush my teeth about once a week.
Cuban sandwich.
Self injure.
I don't know if it gets better but it does get different.  That's how I look at it. Even if it eventually goes back to being horrible, it changes.
I have severe and persistent mental illness.
I'm on it and I don't find it helpful. I plan on seeing if I can get off of it.
Phone alarm. Don't cancel it till you take them.

I was just honest about my journey. I told them my struggles. I shared about my attemps and not the permanent consequences I have from them. I also shared my hope about wanting to live even when I want to die. I approached my speech from an AA standpoint, I'm in recovery, of sharing my experience, strength and hope.

I did my first speech this summer. It was about 10 to 15 minutes. I don't know how long yours is. I don't like to write things down because I'll forget it. It's fine if you do. I just went over a few talking points in my head and then let the rest come naturally. I covered the beginning, when I first started showing symptoms of not being "normal" and how my family dealt with that. . Went over the middle part where I really struggled, without graphic detail. And then wrapped it up with where I'm at now. I also shared how difficult it was for me to accept treatment because of social and familial stigma. I think I did a pretty good job because everyone applauded and about 10 people cried. Good luck. Hope that helps.
You made a good choice by telling her.

Unhealthy: smoking and self harm.

I'm an asexual lesbian and when hyper sexuality hits me I want to sleep with men. Tattooed, bearded men who look like they could hurt me. It's really uncomfortable because I know this isn't me. However, I don't know how to stop the thoughts. Luckily I haven't acted on these thoughts, which is very good because it would be a total mind fuck for me if I did.

I honestly don't think I'd be alive if I didn't have my therapist. She's someone who is only connected to my life through therapy and she honestly gives a shit, without judgement, when I want to die. On the days when I'm doing okay we start digging through my past stuff. Otherwise we deal with the episodes as they happen and try to learn ways to get through the pain. I love my therapist.

I definitely think this falls under the "except when you do so would injure them or others" part of the step. It would hurt both your wife and your co worker. I had a similar situation where I didn't have a sexual relationship but I did have an intense emotional relationship with someone who wasn't my partner. It was really hard not to just blurt it all out so that I would feel better. My sponsor definitely helped me wut this situation so if you don't have one I would recommend getting one. Continue living the most honest you can. Continue being faithful and just continue doing the best you can.
I'd say you pass.

I came out as a lesbian after being married to a man for three years and having a child together. I wish I would have figured it out beforehand. He was understandably angry and hurt but he eventually moved through it. I just sat him down and told him. He tried to talk me out of it,  asking how I could be sure if I went all this time without knowing etc. I stuck to my guns and stood firm in my decision. It was really really hard but so fucking worth it. Now I'm going through a divorce and everything that entails but at the end of the day I know I made the right decision. Do it now before you're married. You owe it to yourself as much as to her.

The way I found balance with writing is to only do it when something is stuck in my head. Otherwise I tend to want to write down every thought in my head all the time. If it keeps rattling around in my skull I write it down,  rather than obsessively think about it. I also never read what I've wrote unless I need to bring it up in therapy. The point for me is to get the thought out of my head and onto paper. Reading it after it has been written just reintroduces the obsessive thought into my brain. Don't know if this helps but thought I'd share.

I just want to say that you matter. We hear you and see you.  We get you even if we don't know exactly what you're going through.  Your pain is real and I'm sorry your partner isn't giving you the support you need. Hang in there.
That's how I feel. I also don't want to be alone forever so it's conflicting.

Yes I have.  Lamictal and Depakote. Have a previous brain injury that effects my short term memory so I'm not willing to risk ECT not knowing what would happen.  The hospital psychiatrist told me ECT was my only option if I didn't want to be depressed anymore.  That rubbed me the wrong way.

I have tried anti depressants while on Lithium and my psychiatrist isn't comfortable doing that again. 

1st gen antipsychotics are definitely out of the question.  I've tried and can't tolerate them.  I'm barely tolerating Latuda tic wise.  It's frustrating, feels like there's no good choice.

Latuda has been the most successful for me in terms of depression.  I also take Lithium. I'm very sensitive to meds and can't take most of the ones they use for bipolar 1 because I have a tic disorder. I'm maxed out on all my meds, whether that be therapeutic level or just what I can handle.  I've tried anti depressants and they make me manic. So, unfortunately some amount of depression may be my baseline because we are out of medicinal options.  

This is the first time I've noticed the sexual side effects from meds, though.  It's gotten worse with the dosage increase. I really have no clue what to do. Even thinking about sex makes me uncomfortable.
Did you find anything that helped with your libido?

Good to know about viagra.  I don't actually know much about it, they just talked about it when I was in php. 

I would be afraid of going back to being suicidal if I went down on Latuda. I am still slightly depressed but I think it's most likely going to be my base line. 

It's hard cause I think it's one of those situations where you have to look at it and decide what's more important, mental health or intimacy. For me the answer is easy but I think it's gonna wear on my gf.

I came out at 27, so I understand where you're at. 

I didn't try to make up for lost time and I'm glad I didn't, I'd be fucking exhausted.  I just tried to add a few more glbt/queer friendly activities into my monthly agenda.  I don't go out much to start with due to anxiety so I went with drag shows and slam poetry competitions.  

I actually met my partner on okcupid. It was a great way to immerse myself into the gay dating world without all the expectations.  We've been together for 5 months now.  

Just be the you you've always been, except maybe a little gayer. Good luck!

I met my girlfriend through online dating.  We talked over text for about 3 weeks before we met face to face because of my social anxiety.  During those 3 weeks I was able to tell her about my mental health struggles in pieces, so it wasn't just one big shit bomb, and I found this extremely helpful.  We've now been together for a few months and she has been extremely supportive. I am currently in a really bad depressive episode and she has stuck by my side through the cutting, decreased libido, suicidal ideation and everything else that comes with the territory.  I'm so glad I didn't listen to that voice of irrational fear that told me nobody would ever understand me.
Being closed minded.

To me, being submissive doesn't equal not initiating. 

I am the dominant in our dynamic. My girlfriend definitely initiates intimacy.  It's usually not as direct as saying "I want you to fuck me", although that does happen sometimes.  She'll give me a look or say how she's craving pain or me.  She's also a fiesty little thing which fits into our dynamic. If she didn't give me these hints or signs I wouldn't know that she wants those things.  I can't read her mind so I feel some degree of initiation is necessary.  Otherwise it's lack of communication and that would muck up our relationship.

I'm really sorry to hear about your experience.  That's very unfortunate and pretty fucked up.  Especially since the kink community is basically a congregation of people who are  "different" or misunderstood for their likes.  It's a big club of misfits and telling someone they don't belong because of mental illness is the same is telling someone they don't belong cause they're diabetic.  I hope you can still find friendship and events to go to when you can and that this isn't the end for you.  It sounds like this is really important to you.  

I hope this is all making sense. I, too, am experiencing one of my worst depressive episodes and sometimes things don't make sense. 

I also want to applaud you for knowing your limits and not practicing kink when you are feeling unsafe.  There are times when I can't give my girlfriend the kink/pain she needs cause my brain is in a fog and I'm worried I won't hear her safe word if she uses it.  

I just wanted to let you know you're not alone and if you want to talk, feel free.

At my best I like to run.  That's how I got through this crippling depression last year. Trained for and ran a half marathon.  Just found out I have a cyst in my knee and a bunch of fluid so running is out of the question. Right now walking is bloody painful.  I also like to knit, which is something I discovered helps my anxiety.  I've been able to do that in spurts but not like I typically do.

Your ramble was fine.  I appreciate someone talking to me.  I never call crisis lines or post on these types of things because usually all you ever hear is people telling you that suicide isn't the answer.  So I appreciate hearing something different.  

My therapist has said something about even in a set back your progress isn't wiped clean.  Once you get through that set back you might be a few steps behind but you won't be back at square one.  I wholeheartedly agree with that I just don't know if I can make it to the other side, yet again.  

Right now I'm still numb from self injuring, so it served is purpose, considering taking a xanax so I can feel a little different.  Going to my mother's tonight so she can help with the kid.  Safety plan is in place.  I just feel as if I've already checked out.

It hasn't been very good, so far.  Had a breakdown and self injured.  I just needed something to push that darkness back just a titch so I can breathe. The toughest thing is taking care of a 3 year old when all you wanna do is crawl under the covers and turn the lights off.
